summary: Phase 1 Frontend UX Polish: add 4 quick-action buttons to the existing Cherry Studio-style composer toolbar (clear draft, copy last reply, attach file, attach context), integrate useDraftCache for localStorage draft persistence in ChatArea, simplify ChatAreaModeControls to a presets-only panel, and apply consistent spacing/interactive-state passes across all major panels.
approach: Wave 1 defines CSS design tokens so downstream tasks have a shared vocabulary. Wave 2 implements all functional and visual changes in parallel across independent component groups. Wave 3 adds targeted tests for the changed components. Each wave task is self-contained; the only cross-wave dependency is that TASK-002/003 must precede TASK-007, and TASK-004/005 must precede TASK-008.

data_flow.diagram: useAppShellViewModel.ts → chatAreaProps.onOpenKnowledgePanel → ChatSidebar (spread) → ChatArea → ChatAreaComposer (button click)
stages: TASK-001: CSS tokens defined in index.css (read by all components)
TASK-002: ChatArea wires useDraftCache + passes onOpenKnowledgePanel; ChatAreaComposer renders 3 new buttons
TASK-003: ChatAreaModeControls simplified to presets-only row
TASK-004/005/006: Independent spacing + state passes on non-composer panels
TASK-007/008: Tests verify behaviour and capture layout snapshots

design_decisions.decision: Keep Paperclip for file upload; add separate BookmarkPlus icon for knowledge context
design_decisions.rationale: User confirmed: preserve existing file-upload UX, add distinct context-attach affordance (wires to KnowledgeModal via onOpenKnowledgePanel)

design_decisions.decision: Integrate useDraftCache into ChatArea for localStorage draft persistence
design_decisions.rationale: User confirmed: chat input should survive page refresh, not just in-session mode switches

design_decisions.decision: ChatAreaModeControls simplified to presets + skills row only
design_decisions.rationale: Mode/level/skills are already in the composer toolbar chips; the expanded panel was duplicating them. Removing duplication makes the advanced panel narrower and less confusing.

patterns: CHIP_BASE / CHIP_ACTIVE / CHIP_DEFAULT constants in ChatAreaComposer are the reference style for toolbar elements
useAppPanelOrchestration.toggleRightPanel is the canonical way to open any right panel
useDraftCache(conversationId) pattern from DocumentEditor is the reference for localStorage-backed drafts
conventions: All toolbar icon buttons: h-7 w-7 or h-8 w-8 with rounded-lg, lucide icons, aria-label required
Section labels in panels: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500
Hover states: hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg on icon buttons
dependencies: lucide-react — icons (BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy already importable)
Tailwind h-7, h-8, rounded-lg, gap-1.5 — sizing tokens
